title: Citywide Data Privacy Policy and Supporting Policies / All City and Proprietary Departments / Safeguards Governing Data Collection, Storage, Retention, Access, Sharing and Disclosure / Cybersecurity
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT the Information Technology Agency, with the assistance of the Chief Legislative Analyst, and other relevant departments, to report with recommendations for establishing a Citywide data privacy policy and supporting policies applicable to all City and Proprietary Departments, that establish standards and safeguards governing data collection, storage, retention, access, sharing and disclosure; cybersecurity and protection against unauthorized access or security breaches; appropriate and prohibited uses of City technology and data; transparency, accountability, oversight, and auditing requirements; and any additional protections necessary to safeguard individual privacy and prevent the misuse of technology or information collected by the City. PRESENTED BY: SECONDED BY: Councilwoman, 7th District
